hints.fileFormat: CSV | EXCEL | PARQUET | JSON | XML | AVRO

assumptions.reason: Process all files in the path (not just new ones).
JSON is a common S3 source format; change to CSV, EXCEL, PARQUET, XML, or AVRO if your files differ.

blockers.message: S3 connectionName is required. Which Connections entry should this source use?
S3 paths is required. Provide the S3 path(s) as an array, e.g. ["s3://bucket/prefix/"].
S3 fileFormat is required. Specify CSV, EXCEL, PARQUET, JSON, XML, or AVRO.
S3 fileFormat '{fileFormat}' is not supported. Allowed values: CSV, EXCEL, PARQUET, JSON, XML, AVRO.
schemaId is required. Provide EventSchema ID or name — use call_mediation_api to get EventSchema Details.
S3 formatOption is required for CSV files. Specify hasHeader (true/false) and delimiter character (e.g. ','  or '|').
